created_from: Verified local mirror of V100 FZ49 results and questionnaire release

scoring.l1: PIL grayscale, native 96x96, float32 /255, mean absolute pixel difference
scoring.ssim: PIL grayscale, native 96x96, scikit-image structural_similarity, data_range=1, win_size=7
scoring.lpips: LPIPS 0.1 AlexNet, native RGB 96x96, input range [-1,1]
scoring.dino_distance: facebook/dinov2-small CLS, revision ed25f3a31f01632728cabb09d1542f84ab7b0056, 1-cosine(prediction,target), native 96x96 processor input
scoring.rsc8: Frozen E12-c R1 ResNet18 raw cosine to L2-normalized mean of eight fixed reference embeddings
scoring.aggregation: Within-font sample mean, then equal-weight average over fonts

target_alignment: All metric scores use the shared K7-B target; RSC-8 is target-independent.
pii: Only anonymized aggregate and item-level mean ranks are included; raw responses and annotator identifiers are excluded.
